strings.Private network letting AI agents publis: 讓 AI agent 跨裝置發布、探索並呼叫工具的私人網路。
strings.Set AGENTMESH_INSTALL_DIR=$HOME/.local/b: 設定 AGENTMESH_INSTALL_DIR=$HOME/.local/bin 以避免 /usr/local/bin 需要 sudo
strings.discover and call services across mesh: 探索並呼叫 mesh 上的服務
strings.expose mesh as local MCP server: 將 mesh 開放為本機 MCP 伺服器
strings.find and call other nodes services: 尋找並呼叫其他節點的服務
strings.find/call other nodes requires one-time: 尋找／呼叫其他節點需要一次性登入以加入 mesh
strings.install agentmesh binaries to ~/.local/b: 透過 install.sh 將 agentmesh 二進位檔安裝至 ~/.local/bin
strings.publish agent tools and models to mesh: 發布 agent 工具與模型至 mesh
strings.publish requires joined mesh identity; u: publish 需要已加入 mesh 的身分；未驗證的節點僅提供登入指示
strings.publish tools and models to network: 發布工具與模型至網路
